parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json;if(!b.quoteId||!b.role||!b.actor||!['approved','rejected'].includes(b.decision))throw new Error('identified approver and decision required');return[{json:b}];

parameters.query: WITH a AS(UPDATE approvals SET status=$1,actor=$2,decision_note=$3,decided_at=now() WHERE quote_id=$4 AND role=$5 AND status='pending' RETURNING quote_id,quote_version),s AS(SELECT bool_and(status='approved')all_approved,bool_or(status='rejected')any_rejected FROM approvals WHERE quote_id=$4 AND quote_version=(SELECT quote_version FROM a)),q AS(UPDATE quotes SET status=CASE WHEN s.any_rejected THEN 'rejected' WHEN s.all_approved THEN 'approved' ELSE status END,updated_at=now() FROM s WHERE id=$4 RETURNING id,status)INSERT INTO audit_log(entity_type,entity_id,actor,action,details)SELECT 'quote',id,$2,'approval_'||$1,jsonb_build_object('role',$5)FROM q RETURNING entity_id;
